grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: to be: is, are
grammarPoints.rule: Ask 'What is it?' about one thing and 'What are they?' about more than one thing. Answer with 'It's a/an + noun' for one thing, or 'They're + plural noun' for more than one.
grammarPoints.pattern: What is it? It's a/an + noun. / What are they? They're + plural noun.

rules.title: Ask What is it? for one thing
rules.subtitle: Use 'What is it?' to ask the name of one thing. Answer with 'It's a/an + noun.'
rules.jp_subtitle: 1つのものの名前を尋ねるときは 'What is it?' を使います。答えは 'It's a/an + 名詞' です。

rules.title: Ask What are they? for more than one thing
rules.jp_title: 複数のものには 'What are they?'
rules.subtitle: Use 'What are they?' to ask about two or more things. Answer with 'They're + plural noun.'
rules.jp_subtitle: 2つ以上のものについて尋ねるときは 'What are they?' を使います。答えは 'They're + 複数形名詞' です。

rules.title: Use It's for one thing
rules.subtitle: Use the contraction 'It's' (it is) plus 'a/an' plus a singular noun.
rules.jp_subtitle: 1つのものには短縮形 'It's'（it is）の後に 'a/an' と単数形の名詞を続けます。

rules.title: Use They're for more than one thing
rules.subtitle: Use the contraction 'They're' (they are) plus a plural noun, with no article.
rules.jp_subtitle: 複数のものには短縮形 'They're'（they are）の後に、冠詞なしで複数形の名詞を続けます。

grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Where and in or on
grammarPoints.rule: Ask 'Where is/are...?' to ask the location of something. Use 'on' when one thing is positioned on top of another, and 'in' when one thing is inside a place or thing.
grammarPoints.pattern: Where is/are + noun? It's/They're + on/in + the + noun.
